command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-11c. The acceptance-test reboot brought the Ollama service back and did NOT
# bring the Docker engine back. Before writing a word about that, establish whether this migration
# caused it or merely revealed it. The honest question is narrow: does the containerised half of the
# HERMES stack depend on an interactive desktop logon that an unattended reboot does not provide?
#
# What would implicate this lane: something the migration changed in Docker's configuration or
# autostart. What would exonerate it: Docker Desktop's engine being user-session-scoped, plus the
# SAME pattern applying to other user-session software (Tailscale) this lane never touched. Both
# are checkable, so check them rather than pick the flattering explanation.

Write-Output '--- SESSION-STATE ---'
Write-Output "boot_utc=$((Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output "now_utc=$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'))"
Write-Output '--- LOGGED-ON-USERS ---'
& query.exe user 2>&1
& query.exe session 2>&1
Write-Output "explorer_running=$([bool](Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))"

Write-Output '--- DOCKER-SERVICES ---'
Get-Service -Name '*docker*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, Status, StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 140
Write-Output '--- DOCKER-PROCESSES ---'
Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'docker|vpnkit|wsl' } |
    Select-Object Id, ProcessName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 100
Write-Output '--- WSL ---'
& wsl.exe --list --verbose 2>&1
Write-Output "wsl_rc=$LASTEXITCODE"

Write-Output '--- DOCKER-AUTOSTART-CONFIG ---'
# Docker Desktop starts its engine from the user session. If it is configured to launch at logon,
# then "no logon" is a complete explanation and nothing about it was changed by this lane.
foreach ($k in @('HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run', 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run')) {
    $p = Get-ItemProperty $k -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    if ($p) { $p.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch '^PS' } | ForEach-Object { "$k :: $($_.Name) = $($_.Value)" } }
}
$settings = "$env:APPDATA\Docker\settings-store.json"
Write-Output "settings_store=$settings exists=$(Test-Path $settings)"
if (Test-Path $settings) {
    $s = Get-Content $settings -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    Write-Output "AutoStart=$($s.AutoStart) OpenUIOnStartupDisabled=$($s.OpenUIOnStartupDisabled)"
}
Write-Output '--- DOCKER-AUTOSTART-TASKS ---'
Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'ocker' } |
    ForEach-Object { "task=$($_.TaskName) state=$($_.State) trigger=$(($_.Triggers | ForEach-Object { $_.CimClass.CimClassName }) -join ',')" }

Write-Output '--- BOOT-AND-LOGON-HISTORY ---'
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName = 'System'; Id = 6005 } -MaxEvents 6 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, ProviderName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 110
Write-Output 'interactive logons (type 2/10/11), newest first:'
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName = 'Security'; Id = 4624 } -MaxEvents 80 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.Message -match 'Logon Type:\s+(2|10|11)\b' } |
    Select-Object -First 8 TimeCreated, @{n = 'Type'; e = { ([regex]::Match($_.Message, 'Logon Type:\s+(\d+)')).Groups[1].Value } } |
    Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80

Write-Output '--- TAILSCALE (untouched by this lane, same question) ---'
Get-Service -Name '*ailscale*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Status, StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 100
Get-Process -Name '*ailscale*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 80
Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceAlias 'Tailscale' -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object IPAddress, PrefixOrigin | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 60

Write-Output '--- WHAT-THIS-LANE-CHANGED-ON-DISK ---'
foreach ($f in @('C:\HermesLab\hermes\docker-compose.yml', 'C:\HermesLab\hermes\start-hermes.ps1')) {
    Write-Output "$f sha256=$((Get-FileHash $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()) mtime=$((Get-Item $f).LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o'))"
}
Write-Output "daemon_json_present=$(Test-Path 'C:\ProgramData\Docker\config\daemon.json')"
Write-Output '--- OLLAMA-SERVICE-UNAFFECTED ---'
Write-Output "task=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'WilliamOS-HERMES-Ollama').State) listener=$([bool](Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 11434 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue))"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
